tests.case: ${mode} a browser request waits for a manual retry and then installs its own provider

PluginInstallViewModelTests.Browser_requ.reason: Website requests serialize behind a manual retry; each completed provider opens its own settings. Native desktop and fullscreen tests exercise the shared controller through production main, preload and renderer with isolated package responses.

tests.case: ${mode} cancellation clears progress, offers retry and unlocks backend restart

PluginInstallViewModelTests.Cancellation.reason: Cancellation reaches the backend operation, clears busy state and progress, publishes the source retry message and unlocks service restart on both surfaces. Late operation acceptance retains cancellation identity.

tests.case: ${mode} website installation reports progress, retries from native input and opens settings for outcome ${outcome}

PluginInstallInteractionTests.Installati.reason: All four original mode/outcome combinations exercise live polite progress, failure, native Enter/controller A retry, successful plugin settings, version and field visibility, and absence of Retry after completion. Only newly installed packages refresh. Fullscreen uses the source dedicated progress and installed-provider pages. Package transport is intercepted; package verification remains in the shared backend tests.
